integrity: Algebraic transfer-graph proof with exhaustive integer SCC computation and independent direct ring enumeration; both standalone programs and their outputs are supplied.
scientific_limitations: The theorem excludes specified short odd temporal periods on all rings and gives an exact first eleven-site occurrence; it does not classify every period or every larger-ring eleven-cycle. An inaccessible historical table leaves a residual historical-priority risk.
title: The first odd temporal clock of elementary Rule 18: a universal nine-step exclusion and an eleven-site onset
